commit.subject: LU-000 util: soothe compiler of discarding 'const' qualifier
commit.message:
LU-000 util: soothe compiler of discarding 'const' qualifier

The strchr/strstr function signature in ubuntu2604 returns
'const char *' instead of 'char *'. And this will cause compiler
warning of ""assignment discards 'const' qualifier from pointer target
type".

Signed-off-by: Bobi Jam <bobijam@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Id4ef3e983b3bc146377acb4dca043f44bd25664b
